content: Cognee's REST API runs a 6-stage ECL (extract/cognify/load) pipeline over 38+ formats and 28+ sources into a hybrid graph-vector-relational store; exposes 13+ search modes (semantic graph completion, RAG completion, temporal search) and a simplified agent-facing V2 API (remember/recall/forget/improve) alongside the core V1 (add/cognify/search).
